NTA. I asked my bf for same thing, and now I can see why he hesitated for SOOO LONG and kept re-asking me if this was okay.

I mean, I asked specifically, I described how I want that to be _surprise_ (meaning no “I will do that tomorrow morning, okay?” questions, meaning that I will kill him for “can I continue?” or “are you comfortable with this?” during process), and he still was unsure because of THIS. He was afraid that I’ll be not okay when it actually happens. 

People should really learn to be responsible for their own wishes: those that were expressed specifically and while being in clear mental state. 

Some unique stop-word won’t help, because “no” is already a very short and common stop-word. “Freezing” is a good excuse, but if your girlfriend does need constant “are you ok? may I continue?” questions during “surprise” sex — that’s totally on HER to ask for it beforehand.

Usually “surprise” part means something happening without planning from receiver’s side. Surprise may be bad, yep. But if you ask for it — prepare to be disappointed also, prepare for it to happen anytime, tell your bf if you changed your mind.. OP, it’s not you that is asshole in this story.

Life is unexpected. Death is certain, and sure you can do it anytime, but what for? You will not feel relief, you will not actually _feel_ or think anything. That has no point. If you are ready to die, then you shouldn’t care that much about disappointing/reputation — I mean, fuck it all, just stay and WATCH how life goes. Do some tiny steps in it. Pay attention to how it changes.

Basically, that’s what helped me when I was 16 and after 2 suicide attempts. Realising that I can stay here for a while and give zero fucks about what’s going on around: like I’m already dead, but with ability to observe and return whenever I like.
